Hannah G.: Uploading pen-test + vuln-scan bundle for Acme vendor review. Zip includes pen-test.pdf, nessus.xml, nmap.txt, remediation-tracker.csv, evidence/, and attestation draft. S3: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/artifacts/acme_vendor_1799994321.zip
SHA256: c3f1a2b4d5e6f7890a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0

SecurityBot: Scan summary: Nessus + nmap. Findings: 1 CRITICAL, 3 HIGH, 8 MEDIUM, 2 LOW. Tracker includes CVE refs and suggested mitigations.

Leo M.: Sales needs tracker columns: owner, team, ETA (YYYY-MM-DD), change-req, oncall, redaction flag. Also confirm InfoSec-signed attestation and a customer-facing 2-sentence summary.

Hannah G.: Updated remediation-tracker.csv in the zip with requested columns. Sample row: 
`ID,desc,severity,owner,team,eta,change_req,oncall,redacted
PT-202,Exposed RDP,CRITICAL,Raj P.,Infra,2026-06-02,CHG-9102,oncall@redwood.com,yes`
Draft attestation addressed to "Acme Corp (security@acme.example)" is in /attestation/attestation_draft.pdf. We can route to CISO for signature and add GPG sign + PDF stamp.

Raj P.: On PT-202 I'll remove wide SG rule, enforce SSM, rotate keys. Can do change in maintenance window tonight; ETA 2026-06-02 to include validation. Evidence files: PT-202-before.txt, PT-202-after.txt, PT-202-verify-nmap.txt.

Leo M.: Customer asked for extended retention to 180 days. SecurityBot: what's default?

SecurityBot: Default retention = 90 days. To extend to 180 days open ticket in #legal-retention referencing CHG-9102.

Hannah G.: I'll get attestation signed by CISO and upload v2 zip (signed). Sales will send to Acme tomorrow 09:00 PT with 48-hour clarifying SLA. Closing unless objections.
